v2.3.4 Update
- Long conversations now display the latest 30 messages first and load 30 older messages at a time when you scroll to the top.
- Message history loading now preserves scroll position and stays consistent when messages change or you switch chats or phones.
- Fixed the Bio Monitor Widget preventing the phone home screen from rendering.

announcement.title: 📱 Smartphone Widget v2.3.4
announcement.content:
Smartphone Widget v2.3.4 improves long conversation loading and fixes the Bio Monitor Widget.

  • Long conversations show 30 messages at a time and preserve your position while older messages load.
  • Messages that arrive or change while older history is loading no longer produce stale or missing entries. Switching chats or phones also cancels the old render.
  • Bio Monitor Widgets no longer stop the phone home screen from rendering.
